name: Space Force
description: A four-star general begrudgingly teams up with an eccentric scientist to get the U.S. military's newest agency — Space Force — ready for lift-off.

videos.title: THE LAUNCH
videos.overview: Four-star general Mark Naird — leader of the newly created Space Force — is pressured to launch a satellite despite dire warnings from scientists.

videos.title: SAVE EPSILON 6!
videos.overview: With his beloved satellite severely hobbled, General Naird must decide between a well-reasoned scientific solution and a chimp-led rescue operation.

videos.title: MARK AND MALLORY GO TO WASHINGTON
videos.overview: While General Naird and Dr. Mallory brace themselves for a contentious hearing on Capitol Hill, Erin gets to know Captain Ali.

videos.title: LUNAR HABITAT
videos.overview: General Naird volunteers for Dr. Mallory's Lunar Habitat Experiment. Meanwhile, Erin tries to throw a party, and Space Force gets a snazzy new look.

videos.title: SPACE FLAG
videos.overview: Armed with weapons that are less than intimidating, Space Force soldiers — led by General Naird — play war games with their Air Force rivals.

videos.title: THE SPY
videos.overview: Flying high after his war games win, General Naird comes crashing back to reality when he learns there may be a spy in Space Force.

videos.title: EDISON JAYMES
videos.overview: A heavily hyped entrepreneur offers to let Space Force use her revolutionary rocket fuel. Dr. Chan gives Captain Ali a crash course in botany.

videos.title: CONJUGAL VISIT
videos.overview: It's conjugal visit time and General Naird is all systems go. Meanwhile, Dr. Chan and Captain Ali carpool, and Dr. Mallory deals with a time crunch.

videos.title: IT'S GOOD TO BE BACK ON THE MOON
videos.overview: With the launch just days away, General Naird copes with an unprepared crew. Captain Ali searches for the perfect words, and Erin visits her mom.

videos.title: PROPORTIONATE RESPONSE
videos.overview: Under pressure to retaliate against China, General Naird wrestles with his conscience. Dr. Mallory makes an ominous threat, and Erin goes rogue.

videos.title: THE INQUIRY
videos.overview: The new secretary of defense puts General Naird on trial at the Pentagon, and the team has to pull it together to testify on his behalf and save his job.

videos.title: BUDGET CUTS
videos.overview: Space Force faces steep budget cuts, to the consternation of General Naird and Dr. Mallory. Dr. Chan tries to figure out why Captain Ali's been distant.

videos.title: THE CHINESE DELEGATION
videos.overview: The team does its best to avoid offending a visiting delegation from China, but Dr. Mallory struggles to hide his feelings about a moon landing denier.

videos.title: THE EUROPA PROJECT
videos.overview: Space Force has a big decision to make: spend their time creating a Powerpoint presentation about an alien invasion... or get into a team prank war?

videos.title: MAD (BUFF) CONFIDENCE
videos.overview: Erin gets conflicting advice about a college interview, while Tony sets up a new partnership between Space Force and an energy drink called Mad Buff.

videos.title: THE DOCTOR'S APPOINTMENT
videos.overview: Tony spreads a rumor around the office that General Naird is looking for a new job. Meanwhile, Dr. Chan and Dr. Mallory actually do pursue a job lead.

videos.title: THE HACK
videos.overview: With the future of Space Force up in the air, big changes could be on the horizon. But first, the team has to deal with the entire base being hacked.

awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 7 nominations total
